context: A retired exec advises on community relations
purpose: Teach: 地盤/町長/奨学/実名/前編/メーター/パッチ/ならびに

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 地盤、人柄で築くものだ。
lines.en: Foundation and character — that's what it takes to build something.
lines.style: Measured, philosophical opening. Even weight on each clause. Slight pause before the dash. Voice settles on 「character」 like a key turning in a lock. Quiet conviction without urgency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。町長との関係、信頼で支えています。
lines.en: Yes. I sustain the relationship with the mayor through trust.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Lean into 「trust」 — it's the load-bearing word. No hesitation, but not rushed. The tone of someone reporting to someone whose judgment he respects.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 奨学金、続けろ。実名で語る卒業生、企業の宝だ。
lines.en: Keep the scholarships going. Alumni who speak by name are a company's greatest asset.
lines.style: Firmer now — this is instruction, not reflection. Weight on 「keep」 and 「greatest asset」. Measured pace. The voice of someone who has seen what works and what doesn't.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。報告の前編、編集中です。
lines.en: Yes. The first part of the report is being edited now.
lines.style: Professional, focused. Light on 「now」 — indicating progress. No defensiveness, just factual. The rhythm of someone who knows what's expected and is already delivering it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 計測メーターの精度、ならびにシステムパッチの管理、油断するな。
lines.en: Don't be careless with meter accuracy or system-patch management. Both matter.
lines.style: Sharpened tone. Weight on 「careless」 and 「both matter」 — not scolding, but awake. Slow, deliberate pacing. The closing word settles like a weight. This is the line where wisdom becomes warning.
